integrity: Analytic proof provided, with independently replayable symbolic/linear-state tests. Numerical sampling is not offered as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The new contribution is a sharp global sign/delay consequence of a previously known explicit autocorrelation formula, not discovery of that formula. Applies only to stationary zero-mean exponential-covariance forcing without independent thermal white noise; no priority or independent validation asserted.
title: Sharp positivity boundary and singular first negative lag for inertial active-trap correlations
